invariants.rationale: Method throws IllegalArgumentException if actor is null, so actor must be non-null at exit.
If result is not null, it must be a Cell whose actor is the given actor.
Equivalent, showing the relationship from the other side.
Ensures that a non-null result has a non-null actor which is equal to the input actor.
actor is always non-null, but this encodes that whenever result is non-null, actor must also be.
